day_shape: Ninth consecutive night of CENTCOM strikes on Iran, three Iranian ballistic missiles intercepted over Aqaba with Iron Dome fragments near Eilat, US confirms service member deaths in Jordan and Iraq, Rubio says diplomacy still open, heavy Khamenei/Bagheri messaging cycle.

threads.label: US strike campaign enters ninth night
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced a ninth consecutive night of strikes on Iran at 7pm ET, framed as degrading capabilities threatening Strait of Hormuz shipping, with six commercial vessels redirected and one disabled under the naval blockade. Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported the first confirmed US combat deaths, and Trump described the deaths of two service members in Jordan as a "shame".

threads.label: Iranian missile launch at Aqaba
threads.summary: The IDF and Jordanian military reported four Iranian ballistic missiles fired at Aqaba, three intercepted by American air defence and one hitting an open area, with Iron Dome interceptors launched over Eilat against falling debris. IDF Chief Eyal Zamir warned of a harsh counterstrike if Iran moves closer to Israel.

threads.label: Gulf states struck, sirens in Kuwait and Bahrain
threads.summary: Sirens sounded again in Kuwait and Bahrain following renewed Iranian attacks, with Jerusalem Post reporting significant damage to Kuwaiti power and desalination infrastructure. IRGC public relations issued "Notice No. 32" claiming strikes on an American early warning radar, aircraft hangar and MQ-9 drone nest, and "Notice No. 31" claiming C-17 and P-8 aircraft were hit at Aqaba airport.

threads.label: Rubio signals diplomacy still open
threads.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters the US remains open to a diplomatic solution with Iran, as Iran International and Jerusalem Post noted the message alongside continued strikes. Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Bagheri said via IRIB that the US had not fulfilled its commitments under the memorandum of understanding and Iran therefore would not fulfil its own.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral message and Iranian defence posture
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released an audio message on the funeral procession of "Iran's Martyr" with recommendations to officials and the public, and Defa Press ran commentary framing recent strikes on southern infrastructure as "arrogance's enmity". Defa Press and IRIB carried claims from air defence and Foreign Ministry figures on system replacement, training and diplomacy-plus-defence doctrine.

threads.label: Lebanon disarmament track and Hezbollah
threads.summary: Secretary Rubio met Lebanese President Joseph Aoun in Washington to discuss the Trilateral Framework, commending Beirut's effort to disarm Hezbollah, while Jerusalem Post reported the Lebanese Armed Forces will enter "pilot zones" in southern Lebanon to test disarmament. A separate Jerusalem Post interview characterised Hezbollah's weekend attack on the Lebanese Army as a signal of potential escalation.

threads.label: Gaza operations and settler border incident
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported over 100 pro-settlement Israelis accompanied by Economy Minister Nir Barkat breached an IDF checkpoint at the Gaza perimeter before Nahala movement participants agreed not to enter. The IDF said it struck a Hamas weapons depot, manufacturing site and rocket-launching position overnight, and Jerusalem Post reported roughly 420 Gazan militants killed since the October 2025 ceasefire.
